discussion_comments.comment_body: This was on an earlier commit that still had the plan check. We dropped the plan lookup on purpose: desktop decides ClinePass from the local provider, not `/api/v1/users/me/plan`. A local `cline-pass/*` model that Cloud offers carries over as is, the same as a local Cline model. Someone with ClinePass selected locally is almost always a subscriber, and a carried model that later fails is the same failure they'd hit locally. Keeping it as is.
[P3] The scroll-to-bottom button uses smooth scrolling even with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, ignoring the user’s motion preference.

Fixed in cc231f9d9. MessageScrollerButton now resolves behavior from prefers-reduced-motion (auto when reduced, smooth otherwise), with the explicit behavior prop still winning as an override. Added a test for both cases in sdk/packages/ui/tests/message-scroller.test.tsx.
